title: Ashfall Art Style
author: Illustrious_Text5021
selftext:
Hello ! Alright guys , I know most of you is gonna say that it looks like a ai slop or whatever , i don’t mind that , i’m planning to put alot of work into it in my free time and i’ve got a very creative mind .

I’m planning to build a 3d rpg game inspired (sort of) Lost the TV Series , like the story to start you waking on a beach next to a wreckage, and find some survivors , make quests and in a different act , people will split into different camps where you can join and then sort of change the main story . I don’t wanna give any spoilers but is gonna be lit and spread over 6 acts .

Now my question is , what art style would you recommend to go towards , the low poly stylized(If you watch the full video , pretty much whole terrain) or the art style more realistic like the wreckage? 

I can’t make my mind to be honest.
